limitations: All references pin reviewed linux/amd64 platform manifests; ARM64 is unsupported by this bundle.
Actual image pulls and native digest/architecture readback establish software installation only; the manifest alone does not.
Installation must not create or start containers, enroll accounts, publish ports, initialize storage, migrate a database, seed users, or enable MCP.
The official standalone deployment was reviewed at ChatbotXIO/chatbotx-docker-compose commit 1b71fc4fe9e21cebbf868e1f1474e8d99a7ca27e; its unsafe defaults are not an accepted Station runtime recipe.
Production activation requires an owning Zone/principal, capacity, private secrets, persistent storage, backups, private networking, TLS, admin enrollment and separately verified provider accounts.
RUN_DB_MIGRATE and RUN_DB_SEED must remain false during normal startup; the upstream seed creates a publicly known demo administrator.
The realtime entrypoint uses unpinned pnpm dlx; a reviewed offline invocation of the bundled partykit 0.0.115 is required before activation.
Source uses S3_ENDPOINT, not the standalone compose's S3_ENPOINT typo; container service URLs and real SMTP configuration must be corrected.
Hermes remains the orchestrator. Installed MCP server software is not a configured or authorized profile connection.
ChatbotX root licensing excludes commercial enterprise code and preserves third-party licenses; community and licensed enterprise capabilities must not be conflated.
Optional Adminer and MailHog maintenance/demo images are not part of this runtime software claim.
